question: Can the exact learned 16-structure Wingless WBG-5 raw-byte hierarchy undergo Yggdrasil-style hibernation, wake, selective lesion, and bounded regeneration while preserving local byte capability and restoring sealed long-range language-like function without retraining?
hypothesis: Across four fresh seeds, replaying the frozen WBG-5 hierarchy then applying fixed lifecycle operations will preserve >=0.95 local successor accuracy during higher-level hibernation, reduce hibernated long-range accuracy to <=0.40, restore >=0.90 long-range accuracy in exactly eight wake operations from exactly 72 retained bytes with exact structure identity, selectively lesion two of four compound/profile pairs while preserving >=0.90 intact-pair accuracy, and restore lesioned-pair accuracy to >=0.90 in exactly four repair operations reading exactly 36 retained bytes, with zero intact-structure mutation and lifecycle cost <=1% of cold hierarchy redevelopment.

wingless_prior.scientific_claim: A fixed 16-structure raw-byte hierarchy achieved perfect sealed long-range reference generalization with 43.75% event reduction.

authority: synthetic computational research only; no production, live, broker, accepted-ref, scheduler, queue-consumer, deployment, external-model inference, or cross-repo write authority
seed_policy: All four seeds were checked against the Wingless repository before preregistration and had no matches. No replacement, exclusion, or extension is permitted.

frozen_reuse: eight WBG-5 level-1 raw-byte motifs and selector
WBG-5 lexicon corpus, grammar, heldout split, and prediction rules
hierarchy_replay.cold_redevelopment_operation_count: level-1 lexicon training raw bytes plus grammar training raw bytes; minimum frozen floor 131072 operations

lifecycle_state.level1_policy: All eight level-1 motif structures remain active throughout every lifecycle manipulation.
lifecycle_state.compound_record: eight raw bytes: two constituent four-byte motif keys
lifecycle_state.profile_record: eight compound-key bytes plus one learned first-role bit plus one learned second-role bit

hibernate_wake.operation: HIBERNATE clears the four level-2 compound structures and four reference-profile structures from active hierarchy state while serializing the frozen 72-byte retained representation. Level-1 motifs remain active.
hibernate_wake.wake: WAKE reconstructs each of four compounds and four profiles directly from retained bytes; exactly eight reconstruction operations; no lexicon/grammar training bytes, hidden compound IDs, heldout targets, or oracle labels are readable.
hibernate_wake.erased_control: replace all 72 retained bytes with zero before wake
hibernate_wake.local_capability_requirement: Level-1 lexicon successor prediction must remain unchanged during hibernation.

selective_lesion_regeneration.lesion_selection: Sort the four learned compound keys lexicographically; lesion positions seed mod 2 and seed mod 2 + 2. Remove those two compound structures and their two matching reference profiles only.
selective_lesion_regeneration.repair: Read only the two selected 8-byte compound records and two selected 10-byte profile records, total 36 bytes; reconstruct exactly four structures in four repair operations.
selective_lesion_regeneration.corrupt_control: For the two selected profile records, flip both learned contribution bits before repair while preserving compound keys and record sizes.
selective_lesion_regeneration.intact_preservation: The two unlesioned compounds and two unlesioned profiles must remain byte-identical through lesion and repair.

evaluation.lesion_strata: Heldout reference patterns are evaluator-stratified as lesioned if either compound key is one of the two lesioned compounds; otherwise intact.
evaluation.structure_identity: Jaccard over compound-key set plus exact equality of learned profile contribution bits
evaluation.motif_only_fallback: When required compound/profile structure is absent, use the frozen WBG-5 motif-only global reference-frequency argmax.

budgets.goroutine_policy: single-process deterministic execution; GOMAXPROCS=1 in qualification

validity_criteria: Exact parent SHA, North Star identity, supported WBG-5 evidence, and all three cited Yggdrasil evidence hashes match before execution.
The baseline hierarchy is learned from fresh seeds by the exact frozen WBG-5 learner before any lifecycle operation.
All eight level-1 motif structures remain active and byte-identical through hibernation, wake, lesion, and repair.
HIBERNATE serializes exactly four compound records and four profile records totaling 72 bytes, then clears all eight active higher structures.
WAKE reads only the 72 retained bytes and fixed code; no training data, hidden IDs, heldout pairs, or target labels are available.
Selective repair reads exactly 36 bytes belonging only to the selected two compound/profile pairs.
Unlesioned higher structures are byte-identical before lesion and after repair.
Erased and corrupt controls receive no retraining or oracle correction.
No structure capacity growth occurs beyond the original fixed 16 structures.
The normalized result carries schema wingless.research-scientific-result.v1 and exact experiment identifier.
Full Go regression passes before probe execution.

classification_rules.supported: All validity criteria and all twenty-six frozen thresholds pass.
classification_rules.mixed: Lifecycle operations recover substantial long-range function with intact local capability, but at least one exact state, selective repair, control, or cost threshold fails.
classification_rules.null: Validity passes but wake/repair long-range accuracy remains below 0.25 and controls are indistinguishable.
classification_rules.negative: Validity passes but lifecycle management materially damages level-1 capability, cannot restore language-like function, or approaches cold redevelopment cost.
classification_rules.incomplete: Environmental or compute interruption prevents frozen cardinality.
classification_rules.invalid: Provenance, WBG-5 replay, retained-state identity, lifecycle isolation, intact-state preservation, bounded-capacity, deterministic execution, or qualification criteria fail.

no_post_result_tuning_rule: After any output is observed, do not alter seeds, WBG-5 replay, serialization, retained bytes, lesion selection, control corruption, operation counts, metrics, thresholds, aggregation, or classification.
